Solopreneurs.Title: Conversational System for Ideation
Solopreneurs.Description: Develop a chat-like interface where solopreneurs can interact with an AI system. The AI will prompt users with questions to gather their views, opinions, and knowledge about their business or expertise.

User Stories.Title: User Login and API Key Input
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to input my OpenAI API key so that I can use the AI functionalities of the platform.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am on the dashboard, when I click on the 'Settings' button, then I should see an input field for the OpenAI API key.
Given I have entered a valid API key, when I click 'Save', then the system should store the API key locally and confirm the key is valid.

User Stories.Title: Create New Campaign
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to create a new campaign so that I can start generating scripts for my social media content.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am on the dashboard, when I click on the 'Create New Campaign' button, then I should be taken to a new screen where I can start a conversational session with the AI.

User Stories.Title: Conversational Interface
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to interact with the AI through a chat-like interface so that I can provide my views, opinions, and knowledge about my business.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am in a new campaign, when I start the session, then I should see a chat window where the AI prompts me with questions.
Given the AI asks a question, when I type my response, then the response should appear in the chat window in a different color from the AI's text.

User Stories.Title: Upload Text Files
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to upload text files to the platform so that the AI can use this additional information to generate better scripts.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am in a new campaign, when I click on the 'Upload Text File' button, then I should be able to select and upload a text file.
Given I have uploaded a text file, when the upload is complete, then the system should confirm the file has been successfully added to the AI's knowledge base.

User Stories.Title: AI Script Generation
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want the AI to generate scripts based on my inputs so that I can have ready-to-use content for my social media.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have provided sufficient input through the chat interface, when I click 'Generate Scripts', then the AI should create scripts that include a hook, body, and conclusion.
Given the AI has generated scripts, when I view the scripts, then they should be formatted properly with scene descriptions.

User Stories.Title: Review and Edit Scripts
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to review and edit the generated scripts so that I can make any necessary adjustments before using them.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the AI has generated scripts, when I click on a script, then I should be able to view and edit the content.
Given I have made edits to a script, when I click 'Save', then the changes should be saved locally.

User Stories.Title: Export Scripts
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to export the generated scripts into a document format so that I can review and share them easily.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing a generated script, when I click 'Export', then I should be able to save the script as a Word or PDF document.
Given I have exported a script, when I open the document, then it should be properly formatted and include all the content from the script.

User Stories.Title: Multi-language Support
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want the AI to support multiple languages so that I can generate scripts in my preferred language.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am interacting with the AI, when I provide input in a specific language, then the AI should detect the language and generate scripts in the same language.
Given I have set a language preference, when the AI generates scripts, then the scripts should be in the selected language.

Solopreneurs.Title: AI Script Generation
Solopreneurs.Description: Implement an AI system that uses gathered information to generate 90-second scripts, including scene descriptions. Ensure the scripts have a proper hook, arc, and finish to maximize engagement on social media platforms.

User Stories.Title: Conversational System for Gathering Information
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want a conversational system that prompts me with questions to gather my views, opinions, and expertise so that the AI can generate relevant and personalized scripts.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should display a chat-like interface where the AI prompts the user with questions.
The user should be able to respond by typing or speaking, with responses transcribed into text.
The system should store user responses locally in JSON files.

User Stories.Title: Upload Text Files to Train AI
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to upload text files to the system so that the AI can use this additional information to generate more accurate and relevant scripts.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should allow users to upload text files through the interface.
Uploaded text files should be processed and stored locally in JSON files.
The AI should incorporate the information from the uploaded text files when generating scripts.

User Stories.Title: AI Script Generation
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want the AI to generate 90-second scripts based on the gathered information so that I can create engaging social media content.
AcceptanceCriteria: The AI should generate scripts that are 90 seconds long.
Scripts should include scene descriptions.
Each script should have a proper hook, arc, and finish to maximize engagement.

User Stories.Title: Review and Edit Generated Scripts
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to review and edit the generated scripts so that I can ensure they meet my standards before using them.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should display generated scripts in a readable format.
Users should be able to edit the scripts directly within the interface.
Edited scripts should be saved locally in JSON files.

User Stories.Title: Export Scripts to Document Format
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to export the generated scripts into a structured document format so that I can review and share them easily.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should allow users to export scripts to Word or PDF format.
Exported documents should include the script text and scene descriptions.
The exported document should maintain the structure and formatting of the original script.

User Stories.Title: Language Detection and Support
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want the AI to support multiple languages based on my input so that I can generate scripts in different languages.
AcceptanceCriteria: The AI should automatically detect the language of the user's input.
The AI should generate scripts in the detected language.
Users should have the option to set a preferred language for script generation.

User Stories.Title: Input OpenAI API Key
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to input my own OpenAI API key so that I can use the AI functionalities of the platform.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should provide a field for users to input their OpenAI API key.
The system should validate the API key before allowing access to AI functionalities.
The API key should be stored securely and used for all AI-related operations.

Solopreneurs.Title: Campaign Management
Solopreneurs.Description: Create a feature that allows solopreneurs to create and manage campaigns. Each campaign will have a series of generated scripts that users can review and edit before finalizing.

User Stories.Title: Create New Campaign
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to create a new campaign so that I can start generating scripts for my social media content.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am on the dashboard, when I click the 'Create a New Campaign' button, then I should be taken to a new campaign setup screen.
The setup screen should prompt me to enter the campaign name and description.

User Stories.Title: Conversational System for Input
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to interact with a conversational system that prompts me with questions so that I can provide my views and knowledge for script generation.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am in the campaign setup, when I start the conversational system, then the AI should prompt me with relevant questions.
The system should allow me to respond by typing or speaking, with responses transcribed into text.

User Stories.Title: Upload Text Files for AI Training
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to upload text files to the system so that the AI can use this additional context to generate more accurate scripts.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am in the campaign setup, when I click the 'Upload Text Files' button, then I should be able to select and upload text files from my computer.
The system should confirm the successful upload of the files.

User Stories.Title: Generate Scripts
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want the AI to generate scripts based on my input so that I can have ready-to-use content for my social media campaigns.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have provided input through the conversational system, when I click the 'Generate Scripts' button, then the AI should create a series of scripts.
Each script should be 90 seconds long and include descriptions of scenes, hooks, arcs, and calls to action.

User Stories.Title: Review and Edit Scripts
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to review and edit the generated scripts so that I can ensure they meet my requirements before finalizing.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the AI has generated scripts, when I navigate to the 'Review Scripts' section, then I should see a list of all generated scripts.
I should be able to click on any script to view and edit its content.

User Stories.Title: Export Scripts
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to export the generated scripts into a document format so that I can review and get feedback on them before filming.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am in the 'Review Scripts' section, when I click the 'Export' button, then I should be able to export the scripts into a Word or PDF document.
The exported document should be properly formatted and include all script details.

User Stories.Title: Manage Existing Campaigns
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to view and manage my existing campaigns so that I can keep track of my content planning and progress.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am on the dashboard, when I click the 'View Existing Campaigns' button, then I should see a list of all my campaigns.
Each campaign should display its name, description, and status (e.g., in progress, completed).

User Stories.Title: Set Language Preference
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to set my language preference so that the AI generates scripts in the language I prefer.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am in the campaign setup, when I select a language from the language settings, then the AI should generate scripts in the selected language.
The system should remember my language preference for future campaigns.

User Stories.Title: Input API Key
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to input my OpenAI API key so that the AI functionalities can be activated.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am in the settings, when I enter my OpenAI API key and click 'Save', then the system should validate and store the key.
The system should notify me if the API key is valid or invalid.

Solopreneurs.Title: Content Extraction and Formatting
Solopreneurs.Description: Develop functionality to allow users to export generated scripts into structured document formats (e.g., Word or PDF) for review and feedback.

User Stories.Title: Export Script to Word Document
User Stories.Description: As a Solopreneur, I want to export the generated scripts to a Word document so that I can review and edit them easily.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a generated script, when the user selects the 'Export to Word' option, then the script should be saved as a .docx file.
The exported Word document should include the script's title, content, and scene descriptions in a structured format.
The document should be saved to a user-specified location on the local machine.

User Stories.Title: Export Script to PDF
User Stories.Description: As a Solopreneur, I want to export the generated scripts to a PDF document so that I can share them for feedback without editing.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a generated script, when the user selects the 'Export to PDF' option, then the script should be saved as a .pdf file.
The exported PDF should include the script's title, content, and scene descriptions in a structured format.
The document should be saved to a user-specified location on the local machine.

User Stories.Title: Preview Exported Document
User Stories.Description: As a Solopreneur, I want to preview the exported document before saving it so that I can ensure it is formatted correctly.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a generated script, when the user selects the 'Preview' option, then a preview of the document should be displayed.
The preview should show the script's title, content, and scene descriptions in the same format as the exported document.
The user should have the option to go back and make changes before finalizing the export.

User Stories.Title: Select Export Format
User Stories.Description: As a Solopreneur, I want to choose between exporting the script as a Word document or a PDF so that I can use the format that best suits my needs.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a generated script, when the user selects the 'Export' option, then they should be prompted to choose between 'Export to Word' and 'Export to PDF'.
The user should be able to select their preferred format and proceed with the export process.

User Stories.Title: Customize Export Path
User Stories.Description: As a Solopreneur, I want to specify the location where the exported document will be saved so that I can organize my files effectively.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a generated script, when the user selects the 'Export' option, then they should be prompted to choose a save location on their local machine.
The exported document should be saved to the specified location.

User Stories.Title: Include Metadata in Exported Document
User Stories.Description: As a Solopreneur, I want the exported document to include metadata such as the creation date and campaign name so that I can keep track of my content.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a generated script, when the user exports the document, then the document should include metadata such as the creation date, campaign name, and any relevant tags.
The metadata should be displayed in a designated section of the document, such as a header or footer.

User Stories.Title: Format Script with Proper Sections
User Stories.Description: As a Solopreneur, I want the exported document to have clearly defined sections for the hook, body, and conclusion so that the script is easy to follow.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a generated script, when the user exports the document, then the script should be divided into sections for the hook, body, and conclusion.
Each section should be clearly labeled and formatted to enhance readability.

Solopreneurs.Title: Multi-language Support
Solopreneurs.Description: Ensure the platform supports multiple languages based on user input. The AI should automatically detect the language of the user's input and generate scripts in that language.

User Stories.Title: Language Detection
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want the AI to automatically detect the language of my input so that I can generate scripts in my preferred language without manually selecting it.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a text input in any language, when the user submits the input, then the AI should detect the language accurately.
The detected language should be displayed to the user for confirmation.

User Stories.Title: Script Generation in Detected Language
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want the AI to generate scripts in the detected language so that I can create content that is relevant to my audience.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the detected language, when the AI generates a script, then the script should be in the same language as the input.
The script should include proper hooks, arcs, and calls to action in the detected language.

User Stories.Title: Language Preference Setting
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to set my language preference so that the AI can generate scripts in my preferred language even if my input is in another language.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a language preference setting, when the user selects a preferred language, then the AI should generate scripts in the selected language regardless of the input language.
The language preference should be saved and applied to all future script generations.

User Stories.Title: Language Confirmation and Override
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to confirm or override the detected language before the script is generated so that I can ensure the script is in the correct language.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a detected language, when the AI displays the detected language, then the user should have the option to confirm or select a different language.
If the user selects a different language, the AI should generate the script in the newly selected language.

User Stories.Title: Multi-language Script Review
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to review and edit the generated scripts in multiple languages so that I can ensure the content meets my standards before publishing.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a generated script in any language, when the user reviews the script, then the user should be able to edit the script in the same language.
The platform should support text editing features for multiple languages, including special characters and language-specific formatting.

User Stories.Title: Language-specific Script Templates
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want the AI to use language-specific templates for script generation so that the scripts are culturally and linguistically appropriate.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a detected or selected language, when the AI generates a script, then it should use templates that are tailored to the cultural and linguistic norms of that language.
The templates should include language-specific hooks, arcs, and calls to action.

User Stories.Title: Language-specific Error Handling
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want the platform to handle errors in multiple languages so that I can understand and resolve issues without language barriers.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an error occurs, when the platform displays an error message, then the message should be in the detected or selected language.
The error message should provide clear instructions for resolving the issue in the user's language.

Solopreneurs.Title: API Key Management
Solopreneurs.Description: Implement a feature that allows users to input their own OpenAI API key to use the AI functionalities, ensuring the system is tied to the user's own account.

User Stories.Title: API Key Input Field
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to have an input field to enter my OpenAI API key so that I can enable the AI functionalities tied to my own account.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am on the settings page, when I navigate to the API key section, then I should see an input field labeled 'OpenAI API Key'.
When I enter my API key into the input field and click 'Save', then the system should store the key locally and confirm that the key has been saved successfully.
If the entered API key is invalid or missing, then the system should display an error message indicating that a valid API key is required.

User Stories.Title: API Key Validation
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want the system to validate my OpenAI API key upon entry so that I can be sure the key is correct and functional.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I have entered my API key and clicked 'Save', when the system validates the key, then it should make a test call to the OpenAI API to confirm the key's validity.
If the API key is valid, then the system should store the key and display a success message.
If the API key is invalid, then the system should display an error message and prompt me to enter a valid key.

User Stories.Title: API Key Storage
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want my OpenAI API key to be stored securely on my local machine so that it can be used for future AI interactions without re-entering it.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I have entered a valid API key, when I click 'Save', then the system should store the key in a secure, encrypted format on my local machine.
When I restart the application, then the system should automatically retrieve and use the stored API key without requiring me to re-enter it.

User Stories.Title: API Key Update
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to be able to update my OpenAI API key at any time so that I can change it if needed.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am on the settings page, when I navigate to the API key section, then I should see my current API key (masked for security) and an option to update it.
When I enter a new API key and click 'Save', then the system should validate and store the new key, replacing the old one.
If the new API key is invalid, then the system should display an error message and retain the old key until a valid new key is provided.

User Stories.Title: API Key Error Handling
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want the system to handle errors gracefully if there are issues with my OpenAI API key so that I can understand and resolve the problem quickly.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I have entered an API key, when the system encounters an error while validating or using the key, then it should display a clear and informative error message.
The error message should include possible reasons for the error (e.g., invalid key, network issues) and steps to resolve it (e.g., re-enter the key, check internet connection).

User Stories.Title: API Key Usage Notification
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to be notified when my OpenAI API key is being used so that I am aware of the system's activities.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I have entered a valid API key, when the system makes a call to the OpenAI API, then it should display a brief notification indicating that the API key is being used.
The notification should include information about the action being performed (e.g., generating a script) and should disappear after a few seconds.

Solopreneurs.Title: Local Data Storage
Solopreneurs.Description: Store all user data, including inputs and generated scripts, locally in JSON files within a specified storage directory. Ensure efficient management of local storage for quick access and retrieval of data.

User Stories.Title: Create Storage Directory
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to specify a storage directory for all my data so that I can easily manage and locate my files.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the application is installed, when I launch it for the first time, then I should be prompted to specify a storage directory.
When I specify the storage directory, then all subsequent data should be stored in that directory.

User Stories.Title: Save User Inputs Locally
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want my inputs during the conversational process to be saved locally in JSON files so that I can have a record of my responses.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am interacting with the AI system, when I provide responses, then those responses should be saved in a JSON file in the specified storage directory.
The JSON file should be named uniquely to avoid overwriting existing data.

User Stories.Title: Save Generated Scripts Locally
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want the AI-generated scripts to be saved locally in JSON files so that I can review and edit them later.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the AI has generated a script, when the script is finalized, then it should be saved in a JSON file in the specified storage directory.
The JSON file should include metadata such as the date of creation and campaign name.

User Stories.Title: Efficient Data Retrieval
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to quickly access and retrieve my stored data so that I can efficiently manage my content creation process.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have multiple JSON files in the storage directory, when I open the application, then I should see a list of available campaigns and scripts.
When I select a campaign or script, then the corresponding JSON file should be quickly loaded and displayed.

User Stories.Title: Organize Data by Campaign
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want my data to be organized by campaign so that I can easily navigate through different projects.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am creating a new campaign, when I save data, then it should be stored in a subdirectory named after the campaign within the specified storage directory.
Each campaign subdirectory should contain all related JSON files for that campaign.

User Stories.Title: Backup Data Manually
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to be able to manually backup my data so that I can ensure its safety and recover it if needed.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have data stored locally, when I want to backup my data, then I should be able to copy the storage directory to an external storage solution like Google Drive or a USB drive.
The application should provide a reminder to backup data periodically.

User Stories.Title: View Storage Usage
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to view the storage usage of my data so that I can manage my local storage effectively.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have data stored locally, when I open the application, then I should see an overview of the storage usage including the size of each campaign and total storage used.
The storage overview should be updated in real-time as new data is added.

Solopreneurs.Title: Script Review and Editing
Solopreneurs.Description: Provide a user-friendly interface for solopreneurs to review and edit AI-generated scripts before finalizing them for use.

User Stories.Title: View AI-Generated Scripts
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to view the AI-generated scripts so that I can review them before making any edits.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I have logged into the platform, when I navigate to the campaign dashboard, I should see a list of AI-generated scripts.
Each script should be displayed with a title and a brief summary.
I should be able to click on a script to view its full content.

User Stories.Title: Edit AI-Generated Scripts
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to edit the AI-generated scripts so that I can make necessary changes before finalizing them.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am viewing an AI-generated script, when I click the 'Edit' button, I should be able to modify the script content.
I should be able to edit the text directly within the platform.
There should be an 'Undo' button to revert changes made during the current editing session.
I should be able to save my changes by clicking a 'Save' button.

User Stories.Title: Highlight Changes
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to see the changes I have made to the AI-generated scripts so that I can easily identify my edits.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am editing a script, when I make changes, the modified text should be highlighted.
There should be a legend or key explaining the highlight colors (e.g., additions in green, deletions in red).

User Stories.Title: Add Comments to Scripts
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to add comments to specific parts of the scripts so that I can note down my thoughts or feedback.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am viewing or editing a script, when I select a portion of the text, I should see an option to add a comment.
I should be able to type my comment in a text box and save it.
The commented text should be highlighted, and the comment should be viewable on hover or click.

User Stories.Title: Track Script Versions
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to track different versions of the scripts so that I can revert to previous versions if needed.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am viewing a script, I should see a 'Version History' button.
When I click the 'Version History' button, I should see a list of previous versions with timestamps.
I should be able to select a previous version to view its content.
I should have the option to revert to a selected previous version.

User Stories.Title: Export Finalized Scripts
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to export the finalized scripts so that I can share them or use them for filming.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I have finalized a script, I should see an 'Export' button.
When I click the 'Export' button, I should be able to choose a file format (e.g., Word, PDF).
The exported file should be properly formatted and include all my edits and comments.

User Stories.Title: Search Within Scripts
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to search for specific keywords or phrases within the scripts so that I can quickly find relevant content.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am viewing or editing scripts, I should see a 'Search' bar.
When I type a keyword or phrase into the 'Search' bar and press 'Enter', the platform should highlight all instances of the keyword or phrase within the scripts.
I should be able to navigate through the search results using 'Next' and 'Previous' buttons.

User Stories.Title: Provide Feedback on AI Suggestions
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to provide feedback on the AI-generated scripts so that the system can improve over time.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am viewing an AI-generated script, I should see a 'Feedback' button.
When I click the 'Feedback' button, I should be able to rate the script and provide comments.
The feedback should be saved and associated with the specific script.

Solopreneurs.Title: User Interface Design
Solopreneurs.Description: Design a simple, full-screen interface with a dashboard that includes buttons for creating new campaigns and viewing existing ones. The conversational system should resemble a chat window for intuitive user interaction.

User Stories.Title: Create New Campaign Button
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want a button to create a new campaign on the dashboard so that I can easily start planning my social media content.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the dashboard is displayed, when the user clicks the 'Create New Campaign' button, then a new campaign creation process should start.
The button should be prominently displayed and easily accessible on the dashboard.
The button should be labeled 'Create New Campaign'.

User Stories.Title: View Existing Campaigns Button
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want a button to view existing campaigns on the dashboard so that I can easily access and manage my ongoing campaigns.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the dashboard is displayed, when the user clicks the 'View Existing Campaigns' button, then a list of existing campaigns should be shown.
The button should be prominently displayed and easily accessible on the dashboard.
The button should be labeled 'View Existing Campaigns'.

User Stories.Title: Campaign Cards Display
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to see campaign cards with key details on the dashboard so that I can quickly understand the status and content of each campaign.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the user is viewing existing campaigns, when the campaigns are displayed, then each campaign should be represented by a card.
Each card should display the campaign title, creation date, and a brief summary of the scripts generated.
The cards should be clickable to access detailed views of the campaigns.

User Stories.Title: Conversational System Interface
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want the conversational system to resemble a chat window so that I can interact with the AI in an intuitive and familiar way.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the user starts a new campaign, when the conversational system is displayed, then it should resemble a chat window.
The AI's text should be displayed in one color and the user's text in another color.
The chat window should have a text input field and a submit button for user responses.

User Stories.Title: Start Recording Button
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want a button to start recording my responses so that I can provide verbal input to the AI.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the user is in the conversational system, when the user clicks the 'Start Recording' button, then the system should start recording the user's verbal input.
The button should be labeled 'Start Recording'.
The recorded input should be transcribed into text and displayed in the chat window.

User Stories.Title: Submit Response Button
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want a button to submit my text responses so that the AI can analyze my input and provide the next question.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the user has entered a response in the text input field, when the user clicks the 'Submit' button, then the system should analyze the input and display the next question from the AI.
The button should be labeled 'Submit'.
The submitted response should be displayed in the chat window.

User Stories.Title: Script Review and Edit
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to review and edit the generated scripts so that I can ensure the content meets my standards before finalizing.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the AI has generated scripts, when the user views the scripts, then there should be an option to edit the scripts.
The edited scripts should be saved and updated in the campaign.
There should be a clear 'Edit' button next to each script.

User Stories.Title: Export Scripts
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to export the generated scripts into a structured document format so that I can review and make further edits outside the platform.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the user has reviewed the scripts, when the user clicks the 'Export' button, then the scripts should be exported into a Word or PDF document.
The exported document should be properly formatted with the script content and scene descriptions.
The button should be labeled 'Export'.

Solopreneurs.Title: Data Backup Responsibility
Solopreneurs.Description: Inform users about their responsibility for backing up their data manually, as the platform will not include built-in backup or data recovery features.

User Stories.Title: Display Backup Responsibility Notification
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to see a notification informing me about my responsibility for data backup so that I am aware that the platform does not include built-in backup or data recovery features.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am using the platform for the first time, when I launch the application, then I should see a notification informing me about the need to manually back up my data.
Given that I am using the platform, when I navigate to the settings or help section, then I should see a persistent message about the responsibility for data backup.

User Stories.Title: Provide Backup Instructions
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want detailed instructions on how to manually back up my data so that I can ensure my data is safe.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am in the settings or help section, when I click on the 'Backup Instructions' link, then I should see a detailed guide on how to back up my data using common methods like Google Drive or USB storage.
Given that I am viewing the backup instructions, when I follow the steps provided, then I should be able to successfully back up my data.

User Stories.Title: Reminder for Regular Data Backup
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want periodic reminders to back up my data so that I do not forget to perform regular backups.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am using the platform, when a week has passed since my last backup, then I should receive a reminder notification to back up my data.
Given that I receive a backup reminder, when I click on the notification, then I should be directed to the backup instructions page.

User Stories.Title: Backup Status Indicator
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to see an indicator of my last backup date so that I can easily track when I last backed up my data.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am on the dashboard, when I look at the backup status section, then I should see the date of my last backup.
Given that I have not backed up my data for more than a month, when I view the backup status section, then I should see a warning message indicating that my data is overdue for backup.

User Stories.Title: Export Data for Backup
User Stories.Description: As a solopreneur, I want to be able to export my data in a structured format so that I can easily back it up manually.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am in the settings or data management section, when I click on the 'Export Data' button, then I should be able to download my data in a structured format (e.g., JSON or CSV).
Given that I have exported my data, when I open the exported file, then I should see all my data organized in a readable and structured manner.
